rule_evaluations.message: Compare no-trade, stock, directional option, and bounded spread alternatives
Aggregate Greeks using each contract multiplier
Keep thesis, catalyst, invalidation, IV, liquidity, and max loss explicit
Decision inputs must have explicit provenance
All decision evidence is validated for research
Candidate rules are usable as read-only gates
Underlying snapshot must be current for its declared fixture window
fundamentals input must be current within its declared maximum age
portfolio input must be current within its declared maximum age
risk-free-rate input must be current within its declared maximum age
volatility input must be current within its declared maximum age
Corporate actions are explicitly handled
Critical market events are explicitly handled
Fees and slippage must be explicit for the instrument
Broker margin must be known for any structure containing a short option
Maximum loss must be explicitly calculated
Unbounded-risk structures are disabled in V1
Option expiration must cover the declared catalyst window
Delay, gap, IV, event, and liquidity scenarios must be visible
